title: POS Sync — sale v1
description: A completed transaction at the till. Amounts are integers in minor units (pence/cents), never floats: 47.50 is not exactly representable and the error accumulates across a day's takings, whereas 4750 is exact.

external_id.description: The POS's own transaction id. This is the idempotency key, so it MUST be stable across retries of the same sale — a till that sends a fresh id per retry will create duplicate stock movements.

occurred_at.description: When the sale happened AT THE TILL, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. The offset is required, not optional: this is the ordering key, and an ambiguous ordering key is what lets a reconnecting offline till rewind current stock.

location_ref.description: The POS location. Required when the connection maps more than one.

total.description: Minor units. Integer, never a float.

name.description: Shown in the log and the unmatched queue. Never used for matching — two products called "Blue Hoodie" would silently swap stock.

quantity.description: Positive. A negative quantity is a refund; send it to /refund.

unit_price.description: Minor units. Recorded, not applied — the store owns price.

meta.description: Free-form. Stored verbatim and shown in the log.
